summary: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing an amendment to its memorandum and articles of association to increase authorized shares from 20M to 150M shares (100M Class A, 50M Class B) with par value USD0.0025 each. The amendment was approved by the board on May 20, 2026 and became effective the same day upon filing with BVI authorities. No consideration, premium, or deal terms are mentioned. This is a routine corporate governance change to support commercial objectives, not a special situation.
